svg.title: One expansion, three goal tests
svg.desc: Animated: tray T17 at P17 searched outward with the blocking-tray cost. Nodes are closed in cost order; each carries the trays crossed on the way. The goal test of each environment decides where the same expansion stops.
svg.metadata: ["The tray to move is T17 at P17. Trays K, T19, T20 and T24 are parked. The filter keeps static obstacles out; parked trays are not filtered here, they are paid for. Each step costs the edge's trapezoid time (here: length at 1 m/s, illustrative) plus 30 s for each tray the moving tray's footprint newly overlaps.", "Close P17 at 0 s, trays crossed {}.", "Close P20 at 32 s, trays crossed {T20}. Entering P20 overlaps T20: +30 s.", "Close P15 at 36 s, trays crossed {K}. Entering P15 overlaps K: +30 s. Every route out of P17 crosses a tray.", "Close W13 at 42 s, trays crossed {K}. W13 is a free waypoint: with allow_waypoint_stash the open-space search would already stop here, at tier 2.", "Close W18 at 44 s, trays crossed {K}.", "Close W22 at 46 s, trays crossed {K}.", "Close W25 at 48 s, trays crossed {K}.", "Close W41 at 49 s, trays crossed {K}.", "Close P23 at 52 s, trays crossed {K}. P23 is the first free parking node closed: OpenSpaceSearchEnvironment would stop here (its goal test).", "Close W26 at 54 s, trays crossed {K}.", "Close B21 at 54 s, trays crossed {K}. B21 is the target vertex: BlockingTraySearchEnvironment stops. Path P17 -> P15 -> W13 -> W18 -> W22 -> W41 -> B21, blocking_trays = {K}: the loop must move K first."]

g.text: Map labels: P17, W22, B21, C14 = node_id 17, 22, 21, 14 (P parking, W waypoint, B bay, C AGV charger); T17 = tray_id 17; AGV-1 = agv_id 1; X@90 = GaragePose {node_id: X, heading: 90}, heading in degrees [-179, 180], 90 = facing -x.

g.text: The three tray searches differ only in where they start and in OnExpansion. Times are illustrative (1 m/s, no acceleration); the +30 s per crossed tray is the code's constant.
